analyst_view.overall: Early view: Paris FC are the surprise of the season, 3rd under Liam Rosenior after a 1-0 win at Auxerre, and face an Angers side that has one point from its last five league games and sits 16th. Angers coach Stephane Gilli faces the club he coached last season; his side has scored only nine goals in 10 games and was without Oumar Pona and Amine El Ouazzini before the break.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. I lean slightly lower: Angers have the second-weakest attack in the league (9 goals) and Paris FC concede only a goal a game. Paris FC's recent wins have been narrow, so 1-0 or 2-0 looks more likely than a high score.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. I lean a little lower: Paris FC win only 3.6 corners a game (16th) because they build through Maxime Lopez and Pierre Lees-Melou rather than crossing. Angers rank high for corners won but will spend much of this match defending.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. That seems right: Paris FC are 6th for fouls (13.9 a game) but Angers are 15th (10.4). A relegation-threatened side chasing the game late could add one, but nothing points clearly either way.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots, with 17.9 for Paris FC. I lean lower: Paris FC average 13.5 shots a game and had 10 at Auxerre, so nearly 18 at home looks generous. Angers average about 12 but will be pinned back.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target. I lean lower: Angers rank 17th for shots on target (3.1 a game) and Paris FC average 4.9, with their win at Auxerre coming from only three on target. Seven or eight is the more likely range.
